pictures.name: river_bank_in_a_far_country
pictures.scene: a wide slow river running through flat foreign country, the bare mud of the near bank lit warm and low along the bottom of the frame, the far shore and the sky above it pale and hazy and without feature

pictures.name: harp_hung_in_the_willows
pictures.scene: a small wooden lyre hanging silent by its frame from a low willow branch above still water, the instrument lit warm from one side, the hanging leaves and the water beyond it green and dim and quiet

pictures.name: reed_pipe_laid_down
pictures.scene: a plain reed pipe lying abandoned on a sandy bank beside a coil of rope, the reed lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the water and the far bank above it flat and grey and entirely empty

pictures.name: strange_country_at_noon
pictures.scene: a flat irrigated plain of unfamiliar palms under a hard white noon, the nearest ditch and dust lit bright and colourless, the long horizon above it flattened out into a bleached and featureless glare

pictures.name: silent_lyre_strings
pictures.scene: a lyre lying face up on bare ground with its strings gone slack, the frame and the loose strings lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the dust and shadow above it deep and brown and still

pictures.name: parched_water_jar
pictures.scene: an empty clay water jar tipped on its side on cracked dry earth, the rim and the dust inside it lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the broken ground beyond it running away pale and flat

pictures.name: remembered_hill_at_dawn
pictures.scene: a walled hill seen far off across a wide valley at first light, its terraces caught in a thin warm gold, the whole of the country between it and the near ground lying soft and blue and unlit

pictures.name: smoke_over_the_ridge
pictures.scene: a heavy column of grey smoke lifting from beyond a dark ridge, the nearest rocks lit dull red from a fire out of sight, the sky above the ridge thick and low and stained through with brown

pictures.name: great_city_wall_cracked
pictures.scene: an enormous wall of mud brick with one long fissure running up through it, the base of the wall lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the great blank height above the crack flat and dim

pictures.name: stones_at_the_water_edge
pictures.scene: a bank of bare grey river stones at the shallow edge of moving water under a cold and colourless sky, the nearest stones lit low and hard, the far bank above them empty and level and very quiet

lines.text: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept
when we remembered Zion.
There on the willows
we hung our harps,
for there our captors requested a song;
our tormentors demanded songs of joy:
“Sing us a song of Zion.”
How can we sing a song of the LORD
in a foreign land?
If I forget you, O Jerusalem,
may my right hand cease to function.
May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth
if I do not remember you,
if I do not exalt Jerusalem
as my greatest joy!
Remember, O LORD,
the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell:
“Destroy it,” they said,
“tear it down to its foundations!”
O Daughter of Babylon,
doomed to destruction,
blessed is he who repays you
as you have done to us.
Blessed is he who seizes your infants
and dashes them against the rocks.
